rdf:Description.skos:note: For open-access journal articles, the embargo date is the date before which availability of the open-access version of the article is restricted by the publisher, following subscription-access availability of the published work. The duration of the embargo period can be specified by `fabio:hasEmbargoDuration`.
rdf:Description.rdfs:label: has embargo date
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The date before which a resource should not be published, or before which a press release should not be reported on.
